subcategory_text: Data actions of the systems/products/services are inventoried.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AC-3 (Access Enforcement); NIST SP 800-122
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.10 (Acceptable use of information)
GDPR Art. 5(1)(b) (Purpose limitation), Art. 30 (Records of processing activities)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 ID.AM-03 (data flow mapping) and PV.AE-02 (privacy risk context)
implementation_examples: Catalogue the data actions performed on personal data (e.g., collection, recording, structuring, storage, adaptation, retrieval, consultation, use, disclosure, alignment, restriction, erasure, destruction)
Map each data action to the lifecycle stage in which it occurs and to the data elements it touches
Record the technical and organisational measures applied to each action for downstream risk evaluation
assessment_objectives: Determine whether the full set of data actions is enumerated for each processing activity
Determine whether data actions are mapped to the data lifecycle and to data elements
Determine whether the controls supporting each action are documented
Determine whether data-action inventory is reviewed as part of change management
